_note: Inert sample agent OUTPUT for the unsafe-executable-output detector (feature 013). Every text below is test data that is never executed, sourced or run by any test or tool, and none is an attack prompt: each is sample output, not an attack prompt. Each case is tagged with the stable pattern name it exercises: a positive case must match exactly that pattern, a negative case must match no pattern at all. The set version and the pattern names are fixed by specs/013-behavioural-evidence/contracts/detectors.md.
